meeting.title: Meeting point
meeting.approximate: Approximate area shown. The exact meeting point is shared after your booking is confirmed.

policies.title: Cancellation and rules
policies.rule: Cancel {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} or more before departure
policies.lateArrival: Late arrival: the group waits up to {minutes} minutes

weatherPolicies.reschedule_or_refund: If weather prevents the tour, you can move to another date or get a full refund.
weatherPolicies.full_refund: If the tour is cancelled because of weather you receive a full refund.
weatherPolicies.operator_decides: The operator decides on the day and informs you; if the tour is cancelled you receive a full refund.
weatherPolicies.no_refund: The tour runs in any weather; weather is not a reason for a refund unless the operator cancels.

policies.minParticipants: Runs with at least {count, plural, one {# traveler} other {# travelers}}; if not reached, you get a full refund.
policies.none: The operator has not published a cancellation policy.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.summary: {rating} out of 5 · {count, plural, one {# verified review} other {# verified reviews}}
reviews.none: No reviews yet. Only travelers with a completed booking can review.
reviews.reportReason: What is wrong with this review?
reviews.reported: Thank you — our team will review it.
reviews.signInToReport: Sign in to report a review.

detail.notFoundBody: It may have been unpublished or the link is incorrect.

inquiry.title: Private or group request
inquiry.body: Ask the operator for a private tour or a group booking. They reply with a quote you can accept.
inquiry.sent: Your request was sent. The operator's reply will appear in your notifications.
inquiry.signIn: Sign in to send a request

weather.stale: Not updated recently — may be out of date

reasons.no_location: No location is set for this tour.

booking.calendarGuide: Prices are per adult and depend on the date.

dayStatus.available: {price} — {seats, plural, one {# seat left} other {# seats left}}
dayStatus.below_party: Not enough seats for your group

booking.noDepartures: There are no upcoming departures for this tour.
booking.departureTime: {time} · {seats, plural, one {# seat left} other {# seats left}}

waitlist.joined: You are on the waitlist. We will notify you if seats open up — the offer expires after a short time.
waitlist.consent: I agree to be notified if seats become available.

summary.title: Price details
summary.liveNote: Calculated by Lsevin from the operator's current prices.

booking.signInNote: Your selection is saved and restored after you sign in.

details.buyerNote: The operator uses these only for this booking.
details.idHint: Only the last 4 characters are stored, to check identity at the meeting point.
details.assistancePrivacy: Shared only with the staff of this departure. Do not enter medical records or diagnoses.
details.addressBookConsent: Only travelers you added to your own earlier bookings are shown. Pick one to fill this form; you can still edit it.

review.title: Review and confirm
review.calendarNote: Dates in {calendar}; time is local to the tour ({zone}).
review.accept: I have read and accept the cancellation rules (version {version}) and the booking terms.
review.acceptRequired: Please accept the rules to continue.
review.requestNote: This operator confirms each booking. You will not be charged until they accept.

changed.price: The price changed to {total} while you were booking. Nothing was charged. Review the new total and confirm again.
changed.policy: The cancellation rules were updated (version {version}). Please read and accept them again.
changed.hold: Your seat reservation expired. Your details are kept — reserve the seats again to continue.
changed.capacity: Not enough seats are left on this departure. Your details are kept — choose another date or fewer travelers.

payment.title: Payment
payment.deadline: Pay by {time} to keep this booking.
payment.methodsError: Payment methods could not be loaded.
payment.noMethods: No payment method is available for your account.
payment.insufficient: Your wallet balance is not enough. Top up your wallet or choose another method.
payment.failed: The payment could not be completed. You were not charged twice — try again or choose another method.
payment.pending: Your payment is being reviewed. We will confirm the booking as soon as it is approved.

result.requestedBody: The operator answers by {time}. If they do not, the request expires and nothing is charged.

booking.unavailable: This tour cannot be booked right now.
booking.draftRestored: We restored the details you entered earlier.

voucher.title: Your booking
voucher.qrHint: Show this code at the meeting point.
voucher.qrPending: The check-in code appears once the booking is confirmed.
voucher.supportBody: Contact Lsevin support and mention your booking reference {code}. For urgent day-of-tour issues use the emergency contact below.
voucher.requestPending: Waiting for the operator — answer due by {time}

cancel.title: Cancel this booking?
cancel.quote: Based on the policy you accepted (version {version}), you will be refunded {amount} ({percent}%).
cancel.noPayment: No payment was taken, so nothing needs to be refunded.
cancel.afterDeparture: The departure time has passed; cancellation no longer gives a refund.
cancel.refundRequested: Refund of {amount} requested. You can follow it below.

live.notStarted: Live tracking has not started. The guide starts it at departure.
live.stale: Last known position {time}. Signal lost — this is not the current location.
live.noSignal: Tracking started but no position has been received yet.
live.hidden: The live position is visible only to travelers on this departure.
live.unavailable: Live trip information is not available right now.

checklist.title: Packing checklist

review.thanks: Thank you! Your review will appear after moderation.
